OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            there must be 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The E.164 value is stored
            and returned (e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. It is stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. By default creating an owner is rejected with 409 when
            another owner already has the same last name and address (the same
            household, compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace). Set
            true to allow sharing a household and skip that check. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of
                firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned on create, equal to
                one more than the number of owners at the time of creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year
                (e.g. 'SMI-0007-M26'). Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners of the same household (same
                last name and address). Assigned on create only when the request
                set sharesHousehold true; it is then given to this owner and to
                the existing same-household owner(s), so all members of a shared
                household return the same value. Otherwise absent.
              type: string
              example: 'H-3F9A2C1B8D4E5061'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) that
                shared the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, fixed on creation. Starts at 1,
                adds 1 when an email address is present, adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0,
                and is capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region) derived from the city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD).
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table. Derived from the
                owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's (business-day-adjusted) registration date at the time this
                owner was created, otherwise false. Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                own fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            there must be 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The E.164 value is stored
            and returned (e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. It is stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. By default creating an owner is rejected with 409 when
            another owner already has the same last name and address (the same
            household, compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace). Set
            true to allow sharing a household and skip that check. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of
                firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a
                global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned on create, equal to
                one more than the number of owners at the time of creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year
                (e.g. 'SMI-0007-M26'). Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners of the same household (same
                last name and address). Assigned on create only when the request
                set sharesHousehold true; it is then given to this owner and to
                the existing same-household owner(s), so all members of a shared
                household return the same value. Otherwise absent.
              type: string
              example: 'H-3F9A2C1B8D4E5061'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) that
                shared the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, fixed on creation. Starts at 1,
                adds 1 when an email address is present, adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0,
                and is capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region) derived from the city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD).
                'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table. Derived from the
                owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:

The full build is green. Here's what I implemented.

## Summary

Consolidated the three separate owner duplicate checks (telephone, email, household) into a single derived `identityKey`.

**`identityKey` = `normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId`** — a new owner is rejected with **409** only when its *whole* key equals an existing owner's.

### New files
- `OwnerIdentity.java` — single source of truth for deriving the key: telephone via E.164 normalization (`OwnerTelephones`, so seed data still compares correctly), email trimmed/lower-cased (empty when absent), `householdId` as stored (empty when absent).
- `RejectDuplicateIdentity.java` — the one consolidated check; escalates `DuplicateIdentityException` on an exact full-key match.
- `DuplicateIdentityException` + handler (+ escalation YAML) — responds 409, mirroring the former handlers.

### Pipeline reordering (`owners.POST.yml`)
Because `householdId` is part of the key, `assignHousehold` now runs **before** the identity check:
`…normalizeRegistrationDate → assignHousehold → rejectDuplicateIdentity → rejectCityAtCapacity → rejectOverDailyLimit → countHouseholdMembers → …`

### Behavior change (per spec)
Two members of the same household (same `householdId`) with **different telephones** now have different `identityKey`s and are both allowed — only an exact full-key match is a duplicate. The old standalone household/email/telephone checks are gone.

### Returning the key
Added a read-only `identityKey` to the `Owner` OpenAPI schema and mapped it in `OwnerMapper`, so every owner response now includes it.

### Removed
The three obsolete `RejectDuplicate{Email,Telephone,Household}` functions, their exceptions/handlers, and escalation YAMLs; updated the now-stale javadoc/OpenAPI references that pointed at them. `HouseholdKey`/`OwnerTelephones` are retained (still used by `AssignHousehold` and `OwnerIdentity`).

Tests: `AcceptanceTest.coreRejectsIdentityCollision` and the full suite pass (`BUILD SUCCESS`).

A note on one edge the spec implies but no test covers: when `sharesHousehold` is not set, `householdId` stays empty, so two same-household owners who happen to share telephone **and** email now collide on the key — which is the intended "whole key" semantics, not the old name+address household rule.

- `OwnerIdentity.java` — single source of truth for deriving the key: telephone via E.164 normalization (`OwnerTelephones`, so seed data still compares correctly), email trimmed/lower-cased (empty when absent), `householdId` as stored (empty when absent).
- `RejectDuplicateIdentity.java` — the one consolidated check; escalates `DuplicateIdentityException` on an exact full-key match.
- `DuplicateIdentityException` + handler (+ escalation YAML) — responds 409, mirroring the former handlers.

### Pipeline reordering (`owners.POST.yml`)
Because `householdId` is part of the key, `assignHousehold` now runs **before** the identity check:
`…normalizeRegistrationDate → assignHousehold → rejectDuplicateIdentity → rejectCityAtCapacity → rejectOverDailyLimit → countHouseholdMembers → …`

### Behavior change (per spec)
Two members of the same household (same `householdId`) with **different telephones** now have different `identityKey`s and are both allowed — only an exact full-key match is a duplicate. The old standalone household/email/telephone checks are gone.

### Returning the key
Added a read-only `identityKey` to the `Owner` OpenAPI schema and mapped it in `OwnerMapper`, so every owner response now includes it.

### Removed
The three obsolete `RejectDuplicate{Email,Telephone,Household}` functions, their exceptions/handlers, and escalation YAMLs; updated the now-stale javadoc/OpenAPI references that pointed at them. `HouseholdKey`/`OwnerTelephones` are retained (still used by `AssignHousehold` and `OwnerIdentity`).

Tests: `AcceptanceTest.coreRejectsIdentityCollision` and the full suite pass (`BUILD SUCCESS`).

A note on one edge the spec implies but no test covers: when `sharesHousehold` is not set, `householdId` stays empty, so two same-household owners who happen to share telephone **and** email now collide on the key — which is the intended "whole key" semantics, not the old name+address household rule.
